nightsiege.guide.archer.body:
Trunk: §eAim§r (more arrow damage), then §eLight Foot§r or §eQuiver Keeper§r.

Then you pick one of two §6ways§r. Every tier is a choice. Talents marked ↔ come from the other way, nodes marked ◎ are hunter skills (Mark, The Hunt) found in both ways. The bonuses only work with the weapon of your way.

## Way of the Bow
- Punch Through for both, then §eQuickshot§r or §eHeavy Shot§r
- Talents: Double Shot, Volley, Impale, Heavy Arrow, Fire Arrows, Poison Tips, Eagle Eye, Fall Back
- Ultimate §eArrow Storm§r, §ePower Shot§r or §eThe Hunt§r, then a mastery and a keystone
@nightsiege:infernite_bow|Class item: Infernite Bow

## Way of the Crossbow
- Heavy Bolts for both, then §eBolter§r (shrapnel) or §eTrapper§r (nets)
- Talents: Explosive Bolts, Multiload, Snare Net, Shackle Bolts, Punch Shot, Tripwire, Braced, Reload Rush
- Ultimate §eBolt Volley§r, §eNet Rain§r or §eThe Hunt§r, then a mastery and a keystone
@nightsiege:infernite_crossbow|Class item: Infernite Crossbow

nightsiege.guide.bonus.body:
Between sieges something good happens now and then.

## Aurora
@minecraft:glow_ink_sac|In about one quiet night in eight (no siege due) an aurora dances in the sky. Within 64 blocks of a core it slowly heals you and grants 1 experience point every 3 minutes.

## Trader caravan
@minecraft:emerald|Every few days a caravan with two llamas may stop at the core in the morning. It stays one day and sells for emeralds:
- 4 of the traps, 2 each
- Dungeon maps
- 4 good things, e.g. golden apples, ender pearls, diamonds, bottles o' enchanting, a totem or a Mending book

nightsiege.guide.classes.body:
Every player picks one of four classes. The choice is permanent, but you can reset it §eonce§r at the core (button "Change class"): all your points come back. This is only possible until your first class is full. You can look at the other classes any time.

## More classes
Once a class is §efull§r (no node left to learn), you pick the next one in the core window. From then on all new points go there, whichever class you play. At the horn a window asks which of your classes you defend the night with.

## Experience
- 1 point per 2 waves of a siege held
- Missed nights are made up in your next one
- Special nights (night fragment) count double
- The ult takes about 15 to 20 hours of play

## The tree
Every class has its own star map: the trunk in the middle, a way fanning out to the left and to the right. One subclass sits in the upper half of a fan, the other in the lower half. Every ring is a tier; where several nodes are a choice, you take one. Coloured nodes belong to a subclass, light ones to both. From far away the tree is a constellation: bright = learned, twinkling = can be learned. Drag with the mouse to move the map, the wheel zooms. Point at a node to see its lines (green = met, red = missing, blue = leads on). A click shows everything about a node on the right, a double click learns it. Everyone sees your subclass next to your name. Red crosses show which nodes you shut by learning the node under the mouse.

## Class clothing
With a subclass you wear its clothes: every armour piece you put on shows the matching piece, whatever its material. Only the look changes, not the protection. Everyone else sees it too. An armour stand named after a subclass (e.g. "Berserker") wears its clothes as well.

## When skills work
- During a siege
- Always in creative
- Always while you hold or wear the infernite item of your path

## For everyone
- /nightsiege eintragen | austragen - sign up for the nights, or sign out
- /nightsiege zusagen | absagen - answer the invitation
- /nightsiege info - state and level
- /nightsiege cores - known cores
- /nightsiege skills - your skills
- /nightsiege mobs - the monster list
- /nightsiege balance - evaluation of the nights so far
- /nightsiege base - check the base: closed, or where the wall is open

## Admins only (OP)
- /nightsiege start - start a siege now (no vote, everyone signed up nearby)
- /nightsiege stop - abort the siege
- /nightsiege test <level> [normal|blutmond|champion|thema|finsternis|nebel|gewitter|netherriss|frost] - test siege, does not count
- /nightsiege reload - reload the settings
- /nightsiege session start - new test session, the old protocol is put aside
- /nightsiege kit <level> - test kit and skill points for everyone nearby
- /nightsiege balance test - evaluation including test nights
- /nightsiege base radius <blocks> - search radius of the base scan
- /nightsiege ereignis polarlicht | polarlicht_ende | karawane - trigger a special event

nightsiege.guide.core.body:
@nightsiege:siege_core|The core replaces the bed as the heart of your base.

- There is §eonly one core§r per world. The first player gets it for free
- Nothing in the world destroys it. Only admins can break it, and never between the horn and the end of the siege. Broken, everything stays saved
- Recipe: nether star in the middle, 4 diamond blocks on the sides, 4 obsidian in the corners
- Right click opens the core window with the situation, the classes and the core tree

## Signing up
Taking part is a choice: right click the core and §a[Sign up]§r. You stay signed up until you sign out in the situation tab. Players who are not signed up see nothing of the mod: no invitation, no monsters, no bar.

## Invitation and vote
Every §e3 days§r the invitation comes in the morning. Accept or decline in the chat or in the situation tab. With §e3 accepts§r the night is played, otherwise it is skipped. The situation tab shows when the next invitation comes and who has accepted.

## The core tree
The core has its own skill tree that everyone pays for together. Donate experience with the button on the core tab.
- Masonry: digging monsters need longer
- Battlements: up on the wall more ranged damage, less damage taken
- Rebuilding: after every night the base is mended
- Fortified: more time between waves
- Beacon fire: monsters outside the wall glow

## Your base
The mod sees what you built around the core. If the base is closed all round, monsters spawn §e6 to 20 blocks outside the wall§r. If it is open, they spawn behind the buildings. Doors and gates always count as gaps. The core tab shows where the wall is open, and particles mark the spot.
- /nightsiege base - check the base
- /nightsiege base radius <blocks> - how far the mod looks around the core (admin, default 64)

nightsiege.guide.dungeons.body:
Dungeon cores wait in the structures of §eDungeons and Taverns§r: in crypts, ruins, illager buildings, snowy forts, in the Nether and in the End. The mod has to be installed, on the server too.

@nightsiege:dungeon_core|The core stands in the deepest room of the dungeon. Come within §e24 blocks§r and it wakes: a sound, a beam of light, a hint above the hotbar. At the same time its guards wake up in the rooms.

## The way to the core
- The monsters fit the place: undead in crypts, strays in the snow, witches in the swamp, illagers in their buildings, Nether monsters in the Nether, endermen in the End castle
- Fight your way through the rooms to the core

## The fight at the core
- §eRight-click§r the core to start it. All other monsters and golems in the dungeon vanish, then 1 to 3 waves come, the last one with a §dguardian§r
- Every player within 32 blocks joins in; more players bring more monsters
- How strong the monsters are depends on the dungeon's tier and the class points you have spent

## Defeat and victory
- If all of you fall or move more than 48 blocks away, the fight is lost. You can try again after §e5 minutes§r
- Won: everyone gets a §dnight fragment§r. A beaten dungeon stays beaten

## Dungeon maps
@nightsiege:dungeon_map|Used, the map shows the nearest dungeon in unexplored land. Only the §etrader caravan§r sells them: 10 emeralds per map, 2 per visit.

## In creative mode
@nightsiege:dungeon_compass|The dungeon compass lists every dungeon kind. §eTravel§r takes you to the nearest dungeon of the kind, §eTo the core§r straight to its core. §eCore here§r moves the core to where you stand; that place then counts for every dungeon of the kind. Plus §eTest here§r and §eReset§r. Tests give no reward.

nightsiege.guide.engineer.body:
Trunk: §eSpike Trap§r and §eSnare Trap§r, plus §eBattery§r or §eFine Mechanics§r.

§6Remote control§r (every engineer gets one): right-click one of your traps to overcharge it (5 s of double strength and speed), right-click a monster to mark it (your turrets aim at it first). Sneak + right-click sets off flame traps from afar, makes the mortar fire an extra salvo and the potion thrower a big throw, or reloads a trap. Every order costs energy (the blue bar), which comes back by itself. Overcharging takes the whole charge for a tesla coil, 70 % for an arrow turret and 30 for the other traps. Talents marked ↔ give you a trap of the other way at tier 2.

## Way of Mechanics
- Circuit for both, then the subclass §eGunner§r (arrow turret) or §eElectrician§r (tesla coil)
- Talents: Turret Tuning, Ammo Belt, Capacitor, Chain Bolt, Seeker, Overvolt, Backup Power, Watchtower
- Ultimate §eOvercharge§r or §eThunderstorm§r, then a mastery and a keystone

## Way of Chemistry
- Detonator for both, then the subclass §eDemolition§r (mortar tower) or §eAlchemist§r (potion thrower)
- Talents: Flame Trap, Shrapnel Shells, Toxic Brew, Acid Slime, Scatter Fire, Accelerant, Blast Power, Creeping Poison
- Ultimate §eBombardment§r or §eToxic Cloud§r, then a mastery and a keystone

@nightsiege:remote_control|Remote control: energy refills by itself
@nightsiege:infernite_pickaxe|Class item for both ways: Infernite Pickaxe

Every siege hands out free traps, already with the warning (the horn at sunset), so you can set them before the first wave. But only up to the cap.

nightsiege.guide.guardian.body:
Trunk: §eVitality§r (hearts), then §eChallenger§r (aggro) or §eToughness§r (armour).

Every guardian draws monsters that attack teammates. Raise the shield just before a hit for a §6perfect block§r: the attacker is stunned. Damage you take and healing on teammates earn points like kills. §6Shield action§r: left-click while blocking. Talents marked ↔ come from the other way.

## Way of the Shield (bonuses only with a shield)
- Shield Wall for both, then the subclass §eShieldbearer§r (riposte, in exchange 3 s of blocking at most) or §eBulwark§r (bastion)
- Talents: Shield Throw, Shield Bash, Iron Hide, Anchor, Counterstrike, Thorns, Last Stand, Revenge
- Ultimate §eShield Charge§r or §eTaunt§r, then a mastery and a keystone
@nightsiege:infernite_shield|Class item: Infernite Shield or Infernite Chestplate

## Way of Blessing (healing and shielding)

nightsiege.guide.infernite.body:
Infernite is the tier after netherite.

## Getting it
@nightsiege:infernite_ingot|Infernite ingots come only from the §ereward crates from level 20 on§r: every crate then has a small extra chance of one. No infernite ore grows in the world any more.

## Smithing template
@nightsiege:infernite_upgrade_smithing_template|You get one when your ult reaches its top rank. Copy it: template + 7 diamonds + 1 infernite block = 2 templates.

## Class items
Every path has one infernite item. While you hold or wear the item of your path, your skills and ult work §ealways§r, not only in sieges. Every other infernite item is simply strong gear.

## Trying it in creative
In creative every class item lends you its path, fully levelled. §eSneak + R§r switches between paths on items with several.

nightsiege.guide.intro.body:
Night Siege turns your base into a fortress that has to be defended.

At its centre stands the core. Whoever wants to take part signs up there. Every 3 days an invitation comes; if enough accept, waves of monsters attack at night - a little stronger every time.

## How to play
- Place the core, sign up and build your base around it
- Pick a class and earn experience by holding waves
- Buy skills, unlock your ult, survive the sieges
- Endgame: find infernite and forge your class gear

Open this handbook any time with §eH§r (rebindable under Controls), with the handbook item, or from the tab in the core window.
nightsiege.guide.intro.title: Overview
nightsiege.guide.perks.title: Night fragments
nightsiege.guide.siege.body:
Every §e3 days§r an invitation goes out in the morning to everyone signed up: §a[Accept]§r or §c[Decline]§r. With §e3 accepts§r a horn warns at sunset and the siege begins at night. Defenders are those who accepted and stand within 120 blocks of the core. Too few accepts: the night is skipped and the next invitation comes 3 days later.

## How it goes
- A new wave arrives every 38 seconds
- A night lasts 4 to 10 minutes, depending on the level
- Survive to the end and reach the §ekill goal§r to win the siege
- The kill goal is shown in the bar: about 60% of the night's monsters must fall. Traps and turrets count
- Survived but missed the goal: the night does not count and comes again at the same level (no blast, no skill loss)

## Experience
- Every §e2 waves held§r give 1.5 points to everyone still standing near the core
- Players who missed nights catch up: in their next night every wave counts as often as the nights missed plus one (at most 4 times)
- Whoever falls in the night does not die: they watch the rest of it as a §espectator§r (at most 80 blocks from the core) and stand at the core with full health afterwards

## Night kit
@nightsiege:reward_crate|At the horn (or in a test night's preparation) your inventory is put away safely and you get the §ekit of your class§r: armour by level (iron/diamond → diamond → netherite → infernite from level 20), the weapons of your way, food, arrows and traps. Kit things never break, cannot go into chests and vanish when thrown away. After the night your inventory comes back, with the valuable finds: ender pearls, totems, emeralds, diamonds and armour or weapons of diamond or better.

## Reward crate
After a win every defender gets a crate for the class they played. A right click opens it (also by day): a band of gains spins and stops. The gain stays in that class's kit for good. Event and fragment nights give better odds, duplicates pay skill points. From level 20 on an infernite ingot may come along. Everything collected shows on the "Collection" tab of the core window.

## Crate items
@minecraft:tripwire_hook|Some gains put items into the kit (grappling hook, throwing axes, barricades, war banner …). §eRight click§r uses them; the tooltip says what they do. Barricades, banners, ladders and light vanish after the night.
@minecraft:goat_horn|§eSecond ult§r (legendary, one per class): key §eX§r, 90 s pause. Battle trance, lure arrow, mirror shield or magnetic field.
@minecraft:bundle|§eQuiver§r (archer): key §eG§r puts the next arrow kind into the off hand.
@minecraft:compass|§eWay swap§r (legendary): nodes of the other subclass of your way can be learned, the ult stays one.

## Level
The level rises with every win. Up to level 20 the nights get harder quickly, after that more slowly (a quarter as fast), without end. Skipped nights do not move the level. Alone, each wave brings 4 monsters plus 1 per level; every further player brings 60 % more. Monsters get tougher and stronger and new kinds join - from zombies to ravagers with riders and monsters from Friends & Foes, Variants & Ventures and It Takes a Pillage.

## Digging
@minecraft:iron_pickaxe|Monsters with a pickaxe break stone
@minecraft:iron_axe|Monsters with an axe break wood
Monsters without a tool do not dig. Bedrock and containers are always safe.
@minecraft:ladder|Ladders, vines and scaffolding help the monsters too: when they cannot get on, they climb. Spiders climb anyway.

## Defeat
If every defender falls, the night is lost. There is §ano penalty§r: no blast, no skill loss. Only a night fragment used for that night is gone. The level stays: the night comes again until you hold it.

nightsiege.guide.ult.body:
The last node of every path is an ult - a strong ability at the press of a key.

- Fire it with §eR§r (rebindable under Options → Controls → Night Siege)
- Cooldown: 25 / 20 / 15 seconds by rank
- A slot right of the hotbar shows the ult, the key above it and the cooldown
- Greyed out means: not active right now (outside a siege)

## Reward
Bring your ult to its top rank and you receive an §dInfernite Smithing Template§r, once.

nightsiege.guide.warrior.body:
Trunk: §eDrill§r (more melee damage), then §eEndurance§r or §eFootwork§r.

Then you pick one of two §6ways§r. Every tier is a choice: one node per tier. Talents marked ↔ come from the other way, replace your own and close some later ones. Hybrid slots only appear for fitting combinations. The bonuses only work with the weapon of your way.

## Way of the Blade (swords)
- Champion's Bane for both, then the subclass §eBlademaster§r (combo: 4 full sword hits a second, iron sword at most) or §eBerserker§r (bloodlust)
- Talents: Keen Edge, Precision, Blood Drinker, War Cry, Parry, Frenzy, Evasion, Blood Price
- Ultimate §eExecute§r or §eWhirlwind§r, then a mastery and a keystone
@nightsiege:infernite_sword|Class item: Infernite Sword

## Way of Might (axes, maces)
- Shatter for both, then the subclass §eAxe Fighter§r (heavy blow) or §ePaladin§r (consecration against the undead)
- Talents: Cleave, Headhunter, Holy Thirst, Vow, Momentum, Aura of Blessing, Earth Shock, Divine Shield
- Ultimate §eGround Slam§r or §eHoly Light§r, then a mastery and a keystone

nightsiege.guide.summoner.title: Summoner
nightsiege.guide.summoner.body:
Trunk: §eSoul Bond§r (companions +10% health), then §eCall Range§r or §eCommander§r.

§6Summoning staff§r (in the kit): right click calls or raises, sneak + right click at a monster sends all companions at it. Companions belong to you alone, follow you, never attack players and vanish at the end of the night or when you fall. Their kills count for the kill goal and give you points. They grow with the night like the monsters.

## Way of Light – Call of the Wild
- Pack Call for both: the staff calls wolves, 2 places for wolves and golems. Heal wolves with raw beef and golems with iron ingots (in the kit)
- Subclass §eBeast Tamer§r (more wolves) or §eGolemsmith§r (iron golems, 60 s pause)
- Talents: Alpha Wolf, Pack Hunt, Snow Guard, Hardened Golem, Howl, Warden's Bond, Wildness, Care. With ↔: Bone Guard and Soul Harvest from the way of the dead
- Ult §eWild Hunt§r (spirit wolves) or §eTitan§r (giant golem), then mastery and keystone

## Way of the Dead – Call of the Dead
- §eSouls§r: every monster that falls within 16 blocks gives 1 soul (at most 10, you start with 3). The bar of the staff shows them
- Call of the Dead for both: for 3 souls the monster that fell last rises and fights for you for 30 s (40% strength), 2 places. Servants carry their name in purple above their heads
- Subclass §eNecromancer§r (stronger servants) or §eSoulcatcher§r (ghosts come along)
- Talents: Skeleton Archers, Ghoul Hunger, Ghost Swarm, Soul Shield, Rot, Corpse Blast, Unholy Might, Soul Pact. With ↔: Pack Call and Loyalty from the way of the wild
- Ult §eArmy of the Dead§r or §eSoul Storm§r, then mastery and keystone
